author: felicepantaleo
body:
#### PR description:

`hltTiclIterLabelsPSet` in `Validation/HGCalValidation/python/HLT_TICLIterLabels_cff.py` lists `hltTiclTracksterLinksSuperclusteringDNN`. The Phase-2 HLT menu (`HLT_75e33`) has no module with this label. It produces `hltTiclTracksterLinksSuperclusteringDNNUnseeded` and `hltTiclTracksterLinksSuperclusteringDNNL1Seeded`. Because the label does not exist, the HLT HGCAL validation of the unseeded supercluster tracksters is empty, and the unseeded collection is not validated.

This PR replaces the label with `hltTiclTracksterLinksSuperclusteringDNNUnseeded`. Every reader of `hltTiclIterLabelsPSet` gets the change: the HLT HGCalValidator and its post-processor, the HLT trackster associators in `hltHGCalSimValid_cff`, the HLT truth-graph trackster associators, and the NGT scouting trackster tables.

The second commit fixes the `ngtScouting` modifier in the same file. It wrote a new global `hltTiclIterLabels` with `globals().update`, which no code reads, so it had no effect. It now modifies `hltTiclIterLabelsPSet` and drops every L1-seeded label, because the NGT scouting menu (`HLT_NGTScouting_cff`) produces none of them. Without `ngtScouting`, the labels are the same as after the first commit.
title: validate the HLT supercluster tracksters that the menu produces
